title.narrative: Empowerment of vulnerable communities through building effective and sustainable civil society

description.narrative:
The overall objective: To promote and protect human rights and fundamental freedoms in Uzbekistan by supporting CSOs, democracy activists and human-rights defenders.

Specific objective 1: To strengthen local CSOs, grassroot organizations, and civic activists¿ capacities to exercise fundamental freedoms and monitor the implementation of human rights commitments with a special focus on vulnerable groups, including women, youth, ethnic minorities, and PwD.

Specific objective 2: To increase minority groups¿ participation and inclusion of vulnerable groups at the local, regional, and national levels in Uzbekistan.
